snippet.title: limekaruza 839k
snippet.description:
free form jazz.

i (admittedly not for too long) tried to get 900k+ but that demands essentially perfect play and a lot of luck unlike 800k+ which is a completely reasonable goal. i guess that's just how it is in games that rely heavily on RNG and execution rather than memorization
